title: 第9章
content_zh: 第九章 我有个哥哥？绿桃和翠竹看着没有一丝变化的小兽，很是不解，刚刚小姐晋阶的时候，这小兽也是得了好处了，可是经过了天地规则洗礼过的小兽，怎么还是原来那个样子呢？“可是雪儿晋阶了？”原本在书房处理事情的冷擎天，感觉到了天地规则的降临，连忙从书房跑来。“是小姐晋阶。”绿桃连忙道。“好，真是太好了！”冷擎天开心不已，喜悦的心情全都写在脸上。“老爷，宝宝刚刚也得了些好处，可是宝宝怎么一点变化都没有？”翠竹有些纳闷地道，一脸期待地看着她们家老爷。“……”“这小东西不能以常理来衡量。”冷擎天想了想道。通常来说，主人晋阶也会带动自己的灵兽晋阶，可是这小东西不但没晋阶，反而看上去还是和原来一样弱弱的，这究竟是怎么回事他也不知道！“……”“小姐应该快出来了吧！”翠竹道，唉，原来她们家老爷也不知道。“估计没那么快，你们继续守在这，有什么事立即通知我。”冷擎天说完便返回书房，雪儿成功晋阶了，他也就放心了。密室内的冷若雪经过了天地规则的洗礼，全身的筋脉被拓宽了两倍以上，吸收灵力的速度更快了，她记得爷爷和她说过，晋阶灵王时会有天地规则降临，在天地规则还没完全消散的时候吸收的灵力越多，对于日后的修炼越有好处，所以她一直在不停地努力吸收着灵力，随着天地规则的消散，冷若雪停止了吸收，指尖释放出一丝灵力，浅金色的，这是只有成为灵王才会有的灵力颜色，而且她惊喜的发现自己居然已经是初级灵王巅峰了，距中级灵王仅一步之遥。自灵王开始，之后的灵皇、灵尊、灵神，每一级都会分为初级、中级、高级、巅峰这四个阶段，当灵力储存到饱合之后就会自动晋阶，不过，由初级晋中级、高级、到巅峰是没有天地规则降临的，天地规则只会在晋阶灵王、灵皇、灵尊、灵神的时候才会降临。冷若雪虽然晋阶成功，也停止了吸收灵气，不过却没有立即离开密室，反而开始修炼起高级灵技来，天级灵技只有灵皇等级才能够修炼　，所以她打算先把火、风两系的高级灵技修炼完在离开，那样她也有了一些自保的实力。火系高级灵技‘星火燎原’是火系灵技里面攻击力最强的高级灵技之一，而且是群攻的灵技，可以算得上是‘爆炎术’的升级版本，可是威力却比‘爆炎术’强了数倍；‘火羽’也是攻击力最强的火系高级灵技之一，不过‘火羽’是单体攻击的灵技，风系的高级灵技‘逐风术’主要是用来增加战斗时候的速度的，是‘疾风术’的升级版，这几个高级灵技都是冷若雪比较感兴趣的，也是最先修炼的，她把这几个最感兴趣的练熟了之后，就打算出关了，免得爷爷他们等着急了，其它的可以日后慢慢修炼。冷若雪刚一打开密室的门，怀中就马上多出了个毛绒绒的小兽。“姐姐、姐姐，宝宝好想你！”赖在冷若雪怀中的宝宝撒娇地道。冷若雪有些无奈地看着趴在自己怀里的宝宝，她也不知道，这小东西为什么如此的喜欢黏着她。“姐姐也想你。”冷若雪哄道。“姐姐不在的这段时间，宝宝乖不乖啊！”“姐姐，宝宝很乖地！”小兽举起一只小爪子作发誓状。“小姐，宝宝说要保护小姐，这些天都不肯离开密室门口的。”翠竹一脸崇拜地看着自家小姐说道。冷若雪美眸低垂，看着怀里有些害羞的小兽，原本她只当这小东西随便说说的，没想到这小东西居然真的一动不动地，守在密室门口保护她，旁的不说，单就这份心意足以令她感动了，心里原本对这小兽还有的那一丝气恼，也随着感动而烟消云散了，从这一刻起，她是真的把它当弟弟来疼了。“爷爷呢？”冷若雪美眸四处寻找了下。“老爷在书房。”绿桃连忙道。“我去看看爷爷。”冷若雪说完，便抱着宝宝朝书房走去。“我说老东西，你宝贝孙女清醒了，你很开心吧？”书房中，坐在冷擎天对面的中年男人，不冷不淡地说道。“当然开心。”“开心的都忘了自己还有个孙子了吧！”中年男子冷哼了声，脸上尽是不满。“怎么会呢，若寒可是我最骄傲的孙子。”冷若雪来到书房，还没走近就听到里面传来了说话的声音，不禁停下了脚步，爷爷有客人？她正犹豫着要不要进去，或是等会在来看爷爷，书房的门就被打开了。“雪儿，哈哈哈，爷爷的宝贝儿终于出关了，来，快让爷爷好好看看！”冷擎天看到门口站着的宝贝孙女，开心得大笑了起来，一把将冷若雪抱进怀中。“哼！”“爷爷有客人？”听到一声冷哼，冷若雪美眸慢慢的转到那声音的主人身上，那是一个中年男子，并不是特别的俊美，可是身上的气度不凡，一看就是久居高位之人，而且此人身上的气势虽然内敛，但是却没有人会怀疑他不是强者，不过，这个人似乎不喜欢她，她应该没得罪过他吧？“雪儿啊，他是爷爷的老朋友了，叫他林爷爷就行。”冷擎天简单的介绍道。“林爷爷好。”冷若雪很有礼貌的打着招呼。“嗯，老东西，怪不得你这么疼这个孙女，想不到你这孙女也是个难得的天才，小小年纪已经是灵王了。”林梁一双锐利的眸子，探照灯似的上下打量着冷若雪道。“林爷爷过奖了，雪儿都是因为灵元丹才能如此顺利的晋级的。”冷若雪解释道，这个说法可是她和爷爷商量好了的。“灵元丹？难怪了，有了灵元丹就是资质在差也能成为灵王，老东西，你真是够偏心的，若寒晋级的时候，你都没舍得把灵元丹给他用！”林梁不满地吼道。“若寒是个天才，即使没有灵元丹也能顺利晋级，何况还有你这师傅在，会让他有危险吗？在说你又不是不知道，服用灵元丹晋级乃是下下策，你见过有哪个天才会用灵元丹的？”冷擎天也不甘示弱地回吼着，服用了灵元丹晋级为灵王的，日后的修炼速度要比自己晋级为灵王的慢的多，可是即便如此，灵元丹仍是千金难求的。灵元丹不但可以帮助晋阶，还能够降低晋阶时的风险，但只对大灵师有效果，自古以来，有不少的灵师卡在大灵师的等级上无法晋阶，大灵师可以算得上是灵师的一个重要的坎，大灵师在地位上只比普通百姓高些，可是一但晋级为灵王，那身份地位便立即不一样了，正因为如此，灵元丹才会有价无市。“反正你就是偏心！”林梁吼道。“爷爷，您有客人，雪儿一会在来看您吧！”冷若雪说道，这种时候她还是回避的好，免得当了炮灰。回到听雪轩，冷若雪立即把绿桃叫到身前。“绿桃，我有个哥哥吗？”冷若雪直接问道。“小姐，您想起少爷来了？”绿桃有些不确定地道。“没有，我真有个哥哥？你们怎么没人和我说起过？”冷若雪有些不悦。“小姐一直在生少爷的气，不许任何人提起少爷。”绿桃解释道。冷若雪闭上眼，慢慢搜索着傻若雪的记忆，终于在一个小角落里找到了她想要知道的。原来又是和七皇子有关，傻若雪除了有个疼爱她的爷爷外，还有个非常疼爱她的哥哥，傻若雪因为七皇子被人欺负，当哥哥的为了给妹妹报仇，打伤了七皇子，不知道怎么让傻若雪知道了，就在也不肯认这个哥哥了。“雪儿，雪儿。”就在冷若雪翻看着这段记忆的时候，听到了爷爷的声音，她忙睁开眼睛，看着自外走进来的爷爷。“爷爷，哥哥他……？”冷若雪美眸眨也不眨地看着自己的爷爷。“雪儿，你还生若寒的气吗？若寒真的很疼你。”冷擎天见自己的孙女问了，不禁有些试探地道，虽然手心手背都是肉，不过他也知道，他还是更疼雪儿的，何况自己的宝贝孙女还因为受伤，失去了部分记忆，他就更心疼了。
content_en: Chapter 9 I have a brother? Lu Tao and Cuizhu looked at the little beast that had not changed at all, and were very puzzled. When the lady was promoted, the little beast had also benefited, but how could the little beast that had been baptized by the rules of heaven and earth still be the same as before? "But Xue'er has been promoted?" Leng Qingtian, who was originally dealing with things in the study, felt the rules of heaven and earth coming, and hurriedly ran from the study. "It's the young lady who has been promoted." Lu Tao said quickly. "Okay, that's great!" Leng Qingtian was very happy, with all the joy written on his face. "Master, the baby has received some benefits just now, but why hasn't the baby changed at all?" Cuizhu asked with some confusion, looking at their master expectantly. "..." "This little thing cannot be measured by common sense." Leng Qingtian thought for a while and said. Normally, when a master advances, his spirit beast will also advance. However, this little thing not only failed to advance, but it still looked as weak as before. He didn't know what was going on! "..." "Miss should be coming out soon!" Cuizhu said, alas, it turns out that their master didn't know either. "I guess it won't be that fast. You guys continue to stay here and let me know immediately if anything happens." After Leng Qingtian finished speaking, he returned to the study. He was relieved that Xue'er had successfully advanced to the next level. Leng Ruoxue in the secret room has been baptized by the rules of heaven and earth. The muscles and veins in her body have been widened more than twice, and she can absorb spiritual power faster. She remembers her grandfather telling her that when she is promoted to the Spirit King, the rules of heaven and earth will come. The more spiritual power she absorbs before the rules of heaven and earth are completely dissipated, the better it will be for her future cultivation. So she has been working hard to absorb spiritual power. As the rules of heaven and earth dissipated, Leng Ruoxue stopped absorbing and released a trace of spiritual power from her fingertips. It was light gold. This is the color of spiritual power that can only be obtained by becoming a spiritual king. Moreover, she was pleasantly surprised to find that she was already at the peak of the junior spiritual king, only one step away from the intermediate spiritual king. Starting from the Spirit King, each subsequent level of the Spirit King, Spirit Lord, and Spirit God will be divided into four stages: primary, intermediate, advanced, and peak. When the spiritual power is stored to saturation, they will automatically advance to the next level. However, when advancing from the primary to the intermediate, advanced, or peak levels, no rules of heaven and earth will come. The rules of heaven and earth will only come when you advance to the levels of Spirit King, Spirit Emperor, Spirit Lord, and Spirit God. Although Leng Ruoxue successfully advanced and stopped absorbing spiritual energy, she did not leave the secret room immediately. Instead, she began to practice advanced spiritual skills. Heaven-level spiritual skills can only be practiced at the Spirit Emperor level, so she planned to finish practicing the advanced spiritual skills of fire and wind before leaving, so that she would have some strength to protect herself. The fire-based advanced spiritual skill 'Catching Fire' is one of the most powerful fire-based advanced spiritual skills, and it is a group attack skill. It can be regarded as an upgraded version of 'Explosive Flame Technique', but its power is several times stronger than 'Explosive Flame Technique'. The high-level spiritual skill of the Department, 'Wind Chasing Technique', is mainly used to increase the speed during combat. It is an upgraded version of the 'High Wind Technique'. These advanced spiritual skills are what Leng Ruoxue is more interested in, and they are also the first to practice. After she has mastered the ones that she is most interested in, she plans to leave, so that her grandfather and the others will not be impatient. The others can be practiced slowly in the future. As soon as Leng Ruoxue opened the door to the secret room, a fluffy little beast appeared in her arms. "Sister, sister, the baby misses you so much!" The baby in Leng Ruoxue's arms said coquettishly. Leng Ruoxue looked helplessly at the baby lying in her arms. She didn't know why this little thing liked to cling to her so much. "Sister, I miss you too." Leng Ruoxue coaxed. "During the time when sister is away, has the baby been well behaved?" "Sister, the baby has been very well behaved!" The little beast raised a little paw as if to swear. "Miss, the baby said he wanted to protect the lady, but he refused to leave the door of the secret room these days." Cuizhu said, looking at his lady with admiration. Leng Ruoxue lowered her beautiful eyes and looked at the shy little beast in her arms. She originally only thought of this little thing as a casual talk, but she didn't expect that this little thing actually stayed motionless and guarded the door of the secret room to protect her. Apart from anything else, this kindness alone was enough to move her. The trace of anger she still had about the little beast in her heart also disappeared with the emotion. From this moment on, she really cared for it as a younger brother. "Where's grandpa?" Leng Ruoxue's beautiful eyes searched everywhere. "The master is in the study." Lu Tao said quickly. "I'm going to see grandpa." After Leng Ruoxue finished speaking, she carried the baby and walked towards the study. "Old man, are you happy that your precious granddaughter is awake?" The middle-aged man sitting opposite Leng Qingtian in the study said calmly. "Of course I'm happy." "You're so happy that you forget that you have a grandson!" The middle-aged man snorted, his face full of dissatisfaction. "How could it be possible? Ruohan is my proudest grandson." Leng Ruoxue came to the study. Before she could get close, she heard voices coming from inside. She couldn't help but stop. Grandpa has a guest? Just as she was hesitating whether to go in or visit her grandpa later, the door to the study room was opened. "Xue'er, hahaha, grandpa's baby is finally out of seclusion. Come on, let grandpa take a good look at it!" Leng Qingtian laughed happily when he saw his precious granddaughter standing at the door, and took Leng Ruoxue into his arms. "Huh!" "Grandpa has a guest?" Hearing a cold snort, Leng Ruoxue's beautiful eyes slowly turned to the owner of the voice. He was a middle-aged man, not particularly handsome, but he had an extraordinary bearing. He looked like someone who had been in a high position for a long time. Although the man's aura was restrained, no one would suspect that he was not a strong man. However, this man didn't seem to like her. She shouldn't have offended him, right? "
